name: com.tencent.tinker.lib.service.TinkerPatchService
description: Tencent Tinker and Tencent Cloud Micro Tinker start this service in the patch process when the app receives a hot-fix package. It applies the patch and sends the result to the configured result handler.
disableEffect: Hot-fix packages will not be applied, so fixes or changes delivered through the app’s patch system will not take effect.
